Acceptance criteria checklist

Every acceptance criterion for this story, mapped to where it's demonstrated.

1

Create & persist with name, department, role, start date — AC1

Filling in Full name, Department, Role, and Start date and clicking "Create profile" saves immediately and the new row appears in the table.

2

Edit persists contact info, department/role, start date, hire stage — AC2

"Edit" on any row reopens the same form pre-filled; changing any of those fields and saving updates the row in place.

3

Missing a required field is not saved — AC3

Submitting with Name, Department, Role, or Start date blank leaves the table unchanged — nothing is written.

4

Validation error names the missing field — AC4

Each blocked submission shows an inline error directly under the offending field — see "Required-field validation".

5

Blank email/phone still creates successfully — AC5

With Name, Department, Role, and Start date present, leaving Email and Phone blank saves without error.

6

Rehire saves as a standalone profile — AC6

"Create rehire profile" on Sam Okafor's row creates a new profile with its own ID and no reference back to the prior one — see "Rehire — standalone profiles".
